raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the IMDb data, incorrectly recording Denmark’s release year for Gaza Ghetto as 1998 instead of 1988, then concluded Gaza Ghetto (1998) was more recent than Kull the Conqueror (1997). This typo and the flawed choice to compare latest regional releases rather than initial release dates led to the wrong conclusion.
